scenes.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create a polished high-resolution TWO-PANEL comparison board, equal panels side by side with a narrow cream gutter and small elegant labels in a cream header. Left label 'LAST TRAIN, FIRST LIGHT'; right label 'LITTLE TOKYO'. Input 1 is the photographic scene and composition reference. Input 2 is the locked Last Train First Light style board; input 3 the locked Little Tokyo style board. Render the SAME input-1 city scene, camera, geometry, architectural density and daytime sunlight in both panels, including its distinctive structures, not the waterfront layout of the style boards. Left: richly detailed hand-painted anime environment art, delicate architectural linework, textured pigment and painterly shadows, luminous restrained colors, calm indie-film atmosphere, convincing detailed Tokyo architecture, subtle aerial perspective, minimal depth blur. Right: exquisite physically tactile miniature city photographed through a traditional lens, realistic tiny buildings, fine facade and rooftop materials, warm sunlight and cool shadows, selective tilt-shift depth of field with a broad sharply resolved central subject and gentle foreground/background falloff. Preserve the reference's irregular mixed heights, very dense packed narrow lots and roof clutter, close building spacing, infrastructure proportions. Absolutely no sparse generic box city, giant toy bricks, outlines on miniature style, fantasy towers or added landmarks. Original stylized concept interpretation for project reference, not a reproduction of stock image overlays; exclude watermarks and stock-image borders. Preserve scene identity and details at a high art bar. Each panel should fit the full original scene composition without cropping critical infrastructure; adapt overall board aspect to input scene. Scene 1: oblique overhead neighborhood mosaic, busy varied roofscape, white cream brick-red and turquoise mid-rise blocks, taller city masses behind. Keep the color accents and compact central jumble. Wide comparison board.
